page.notes: The Greek word after "Hevæ," is only partly legible; the reading ἀνδρὶ is a guess and is marked [?]. The word "nosti" in the first paragraph is doubtful, as the long-s ligature is unclear; it is marked [?]. The reference "Genef. 21." stands on its own at the start of a line and is treated as a marginal reference set at that point. The paragraph ends on a hyphenated word "ve-" and the catchword "lamen" continues it on the next page.
